q1_what_did_you_play: I played Mine Toss first, then Spirited Away, then Bag of Tricks choosing its 3-Spark option against Nibbit, and finally Firework Finale against Nibbit. This uses all 3 energy, pays for both Spark-costed cards by using the Spark gained from the placed Bombs, deals 38 total damage, and gains 12 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Bag of Tricks’ 3-Spark option, Firework Finale, Spirited Away, and Duck and Cover instead of Mine Toss. That line would deal 33 damage and gain 17 Block, trading 5 damage for 5 extra Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the extra 5 Block from Duck and Cover. Since Nibbit’s telegraphed attack is exactly 12, that extra Block would not have changed survival this turn, so I prioritized the additional 5 damage from Mine Toss.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit’s intent had been an attack for more than 12 damage, I would have preferred the higher-Block line with Spirited Away and Duck and Cover instead of Mine Toss, because the chosen line’s 12 Block would no longer fully cover the attack.
